Players of all skill levels are encouraged to sign up, but high skill players may be removed in order to balance the draft pool. Hold tight for scheduling information including signup cutoff date, draft date, and season start.

== Format ==
The season will consist of an initial group stage to determine playoff bracket seeding based on total map wins. 

'''GROUP STAGE'''

Group stage will be GO3 (game of 3) where three maps are played. Each team plays every other team one time during group play.

/CMD RND to determine Team 1.  Team 1 picks a map and the map is played.  Team 2 picks 2nd map and the map is played.  To determine the 3rd map: If one team is down 2-0, they pick the 3rd map.  If the series is tied 1-1, Team 2 bans a map, then Team 1 picks from the remaining two maps for the final play.

'''PLAYOFF BRACKET'''

Playoff games will be BO3 (best of three) where 2 wins takes the victory. 

/CMD RND to determine Team 1.  Team 1 picks a map and the map is played.  Team 2 picks a map and the map is played. To determine the 3rd map if the series is tied 1-1: Team 2 bans a map, then Team 1 picks from the remaining two maps for the final play.

'''TIMEFRAME'''

There will be 1 game per week. Teams schedule the game themselves within that week.

'''RULES'''

* No Cheating.  Cheaters instantly banned and shamed forever more.
* All games must be played on North American servers.
* Servers should be selected in order to provide the lowest average ping for all players.  Pinging up to increase team average to match the opponents average ping is allowed.  In case of a dispute, league admin determines the server.
* Clients/Ruleset: ezquake 3.6.x ruleset smackdown, smackdrive, or qcon, or unezquake 1.2.x reporting "clear" + SOCD allowed.
* 1 standin allowed per team if scheduling issues arise.  All standins must be approved by the opposing team. Standins cannot be a member of another draft team.
* Playoff seeding is based on total map wins.  In case of a tie between teams, the result of the head to head group stage game between those two teams is used as a tie-breaker.  In case of a three-way tie where head to head results do not break a tie (is this possible? admins didn't care to do the math and check), total frag margin in head to head games is used as a tie-breaker.
